1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 e6 3.e4 c5 4.e5.strategy: Gains space and attacks the knight in one move, before Black has developed another piece. The pawn is advanced and for the moment defended by nothing, so White must support it soon, but the lead in space is real and Black has to spend time on the retreat.

1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 e6 3.e4 c5 4.e5 Ng8.strategy: The knight goes back to its home square: Black loses time and falls behind in development, but the pawn structure stays intact and White's e5 pawn has to be defended. Black plays to undermine that pawn and win back the time with pressure on the centre.
1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 e6 3.e4 c5 4.e5 Ng8.name: English Opening: Anglo-Indian Defence, Flohr-Mikenas-Carls Variation, Nei Gambit
